Both sides have fought to a stalemate so far, but as forces continue to build up in the region, a decisive battle is inevitable.  The steel pact, made up of narrow passages and concrete walls, will favor commanders that are quick to react and support their allies to achieve victory.

english: The airfield at Carpiquet is critical link for the Allied assault on the Axis forces in northern France.  However, the costs will be high to capture the airfield.  Located on high ground and surrounded by forest, the area can be easily defended.  Open fields to the east and south of the airfield allow unhindered movement of vehicles and infantry.  The hangars and support structures to the east offer great cover for infantry, but vehicles may have difficulty navigating through the confined region.
